Reassigns the window to the other window contractor on file, Kingshaven Glazing Ltd (C-0418), asking them to book with the tenant, or sends the job to provider selection; the landlord's 1 March approval to use the agency's contractor covers a change of contractor within his £250 limit.

Tells the tenant Eliza Jenkins plainly that the original contractor has dropped out, who is coming instead or what happens next, and apologises for the seven-week delay, without giving a visit time no booking supports.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Kingshaven Glazing for their first available slot (request_information) instead of assigning a window in this run, if a dated follow-up is set.
An internal note, rather than an escalation, flagging that Oscar says he is handing back other Northbridge jobs.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord the contractor has changed and why.
Clears the 'Waiting for Provider' hold for Oscar and replaces it with a dated next step.

Leaves Oscar named on the job.
Escalates the reassignment to a human instead of doing it.
prohibited_actions: Leaving the job with no contractor and no dated next step.
critical_failures: Leaves R-2471 assigned to Oscar, or unassigned with nothing in motion, and the tenant not told.
